'''Revelation Ralltiir Operations is alive and well''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 30 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 ROps Revelation DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

How many people actually play with Ounee Tay???

The published list has 70 cards.

== Strategy ==

Outgenerate your opponent, take control of Ralltiir, then flip and beatdown. This deck is very beatdown capable. tyranus: I wish I had more S Garrisons! I'll check Davod Jon.
